_pipeline_lineage.title: Regularization Dynamics (Lasso L1, Ridge L2, ElasticNet)

upstream.source_data: Stage 03 features + Stage 05 unregularized logistic model weights.
upstream.inherited_hypotheses: L1 penalty performs embedded feature selection; L2 penalty shrinks redundant weights and prevents overfitting.

mathematical_transition.theoretical_motivation: Unconstrained log-loss optimization leads to variance inflation when features are collinear. Adding norms shrinks the parameter vector toward zero.
mathematical_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(k \cdot p \cdot N) \text{ via Coordinate Descent / L-BFGS}

downstream.hand_off_contract: Confirms Ridge L2 achieves AUC = 0.6482, while showing linear models hit performance ceiling due to lack of non-linear interaction modeling.

adtech_role.system_component: Sparse Model Compression for Edge & Mobile SDKs
adtech_role.business_impact: Reduces memory footprint of weights by 40%, enabling local on-device CTR inference inside mobile apps without server round-trips.
